description: This file serves as the entry point for a React-based web application. It imports React, React DOM, a CSS file, and the main App component. It initializes the React application by rendering the App component into the DOM element with id 'root', wrapping it with React.StrictMode for highlighting potential problems.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Calls ReactDOM root render method to display the App component inside the DOM element with id 'root'.
